user_intent: Replace the static Headspace mobile image with a pixel-accurate animated walkthrough of a 7-frame Figma storyboard as one 414x816 phone, then add a second animated phone frame beside it.
resolution: Extracted each Figma frame individually with get_design_context, exported complex hero illustrations and front-page rasters as PNG/SVG via download_assets + curl into src/assets/headspace-demo/, sampled exact divider colors from reference PNGs with PIL, and built a timer-driven state machine component verified with Playwright screenshot loops against the password-gated dev server. A key fix: locally installed 'Apercu Mono' was aliasing the Figma font stack to monospace, resolved by subsetting the user's real Apercu OTFs (Regular/Medium/Bold) to woff2 via fonttools using the scripts/subset-fonts.sh recipe and scoping @font-face as 'Apercu Demo'. A second component (HeadspaceReflectionDemo) reused the same pipeline for an animate-in-only phone 32px to the left.
